title: Cold Satori
description: Silence the panic response. Master the initial shock of frozen immersion through deliberate breathing and mental control.

title: Iron Dawn
description: Rise before the sun and complete a full-body resistance session. Prove your commitment before the world wakes up.

title: The Carry
description: Perform a loaded carry challenge — farmer's walk, sandbag, or any heavy object — for distance and time.

title: Spartan 300
description: Complete 300 reps of any bodyweight movement without stopping. No equipment required. Only will.

title: The Plunge
description: Submerge in cold water for at least 3 minutes. No hesitation. No early exit. Document the timer.

title: Brick Foundation
description: Complete a 5km run immediately followed by 20 minutes of strength work. Back-to-back, no rest between.

title: Stone Grip
description: Hang from a bar for a total of 5 accumulated minutes throughout the day. Log each set.

title: Midnight Map
description: Navigate 10km on foot after midnight. Urban or trail. GPS map and a photo of the route required.

title: The Traverse
description: Complete a continuous 20km walk or hike in a single session. No vehicle assistance. Elevation bonus if applicable.

title: Rooftop Protocol
description: Find the highest accessible point in your city and document your view from the top. Creative routes encouraged.

title: Mobility Unlock
description: Complete a 45-minute mobility and flexibility session. Document at least 3 key stretches with hold times.

title: Sprint Intervals
description: Complete 10 x 100m all-out sprints with 90-second rest between each. Timing required.

title: The Unseen Path
description: Go somewhere you've never been before within your city or region. No destination planning allowed — navigate by feel.

title: Vertical Mile
description: Accumulate 1 mile (1.6km) of vertical elevation gain in a single day — stairs, hills, or climbing.

title: Scriptorium
description: Complete a 4-hour uninterrupted deep work session on a single meaningful task. No context switching allowed.

title: The Codex
description: Read a full non-fiction book in one sitting or across 3 days maximum. Write a 300-word synthesis of what you learned.

title: Teach to Learn
description: Identify something you know well and teach it to another person — in person, online, or through written material.

title: The Audit
description: Conduct a full financial audit of the past 30 days. Categorise every transaction and identify two areas to optimise.

title: Skill Sprint
description: Dedicate 7 consecutive days to learning one new skill — one focused hour per day. Document each session.

title: Build Something
description: Create something tangible that didn't exist before — a tool, a piece of code, an essay, or a physical object.

title: The Interrogation
description: Interview someone 10+ years further along in a path you care about. Extract at least 5 actionable lessons.

title: Portfolio Protocol
description: Research and document a complete investment thesis for one asset class. Write it as if presenting to a panel.

title: The Blank Canvas
description: Create a piece of original art — drawing, painting, digital, or sculpture — in one uninterrupted session.

title: Signal from Noise
description: Spend 24 hours without social media or news. Document what you noticed, felt, and created in the absence of noise.

title: The Dialogue
description: Have a meaningful, screen-free conversation lasting over 1 hour with someone you rarely speak deeply with.

title: 30 Rejections
description: Put yourself in 5 situations this week where you might be told no — ask, pitch, or initiate something uncomfortable.

title: Dawn Ritual
description: Complete a structured morning routine every day for 7 days: wake by 6am, move, journal, and no phone for 1 hour.

title: The Detox
description: Cut out one substance or habit that you rely on daily — caffeine, alcohol, sugar — for a full 7 days.

title: Breath Mastery
description: Complete a breathwork session each day for 5 days. Document heart rate, focus, and mood before and after each session.

title: The Pitch
description: Identify an idea you believe in and pitch it — to a friend, an employer, an investor, or the internet.
